title: Global sections of the derived internal Hom
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be a site whose underlying category is small and $\mathcal O$ a sheaf of commutative rings on $\mathcal C$; let $D(\mathcal O)$ be the derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] of the abelian category of $\mathcal O$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and $\Gamma(\mathcal C,-)=\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O}(\mathcal O,-)$ the global sections functor. For $K\in D(\mathcal O)$ put $H^0(\mathcal C,K)=H^0(\Gamma(\mathcal C,\mathcal J^\bullet))$ for a K-injective complex $\mathcal J^\bullet$ [def-pur-kinjective-complex] representing $K$ (one exists by [prop-pur-kinjective-resolutions-exist]; the result does not depend on the choice up to canonical isomorphism, as two K-injective complexes representing $K$ are homotopy equivalent). Then for $L,M\in D(\mathcal O)$ there is a canonical isomorphism

$$
 H^0\bigl(\mathcal C,R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O}(L,M)\bigr)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal O)}(L,M),
$$

with $R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O}$ the derived internal Hom [def-pur-derived-internal-hom].
